summary: Kazia Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting a clinical milestone, not a special situation. Sovargen Co. dosed the first patient in a Phase 1b/2a trial of paxalisib for rare mTORopathy-related epilepsies (FCD T2 and TSC), triggering a $2 million development payment to Kazia under the March 2024 exclusive license. Kazia remains eligible for up to $17 million in further milestones plus royalties and sublicensing revenue. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are presented. Risk-arb angle: none; this is a routine R&D update with milestone economics rather than a deal event.
